verdict.rationale: The evidence pack never mentions a Vulkan backend. Auto-detecting AMD GPUs and downloading an appropriate backend is adjacent: it does not show Vulkan acceleration or avoiding a ROCm install. The axis applies to a local inference runtime, but the capability is unevidenced.

support.subject: As a power-user, I can accelerate inference on AMD GPUs via a Vulkan backend without needing a full ROCm install
